notes: Evaluation profiles for search_set_profile. 'base' is 'player' (the build's own active config set) or 'fresh' (a new PoB-default config set). 'carry_prefixes' copies the player's config inputs whose names start with a prefix into a fresh set (quest rewards, bandit and pantheon are character state, not combat assumptions). 'config' sets PoB config vars (ConfigOptions.lua names) on top. 'scoring' is plain data for the caller's scorer; the engine never applies it.  default_config: usual endgame quest picks for a fresh config set (the player's own picks, carried by carry_prefixes, win) and Rage at the build's maximum (PoB caps the config at MaximumRage and only applies it when the build can gain Rage). mapping_v1 sets Warcry Power 15: PoB only sets Power for bosses.

as_exported.description: The player's own config set, as exported. Includes any conditional toggles the player turned on.

pinnacle_v1.description: Single Pinnacle boss. Fresh PoB-default config (no conditional toggles), character state carried over.
